question: Advisor headcount over the last eight quarters across the five.

claims.text: The advisor headcount series for the last eight quarters can be stated only for Edward Jones, which reported 20,514 financial advisors at period end for the second quarter of 2026 (ended June 26, 2026) and 19,674 in the U.S. segment for the first quarter of 2026 (ended March 27, 2026).
Edward Jones's whole-firm count fell from 20,429 at September 26, 2025 to 20,309 at June 27, 2025, then rose to 20,514 by June 26, 2026.
Raymond James ended fiscal 2025 with a record 8,943 financial advisors as of September 30, 2025, up from 8,787 as of September 30, 2024.
A comparison across the five firms cannot be made on this evidence, because the firms define the metric differently and no single shared eight-quarter series exists for all of them.

adjacent.text: Schwab stated it has 32,000 employees working together, rather than an eight-quarter advisor headcount series.
adjacent.differs_because: Total employees is a different measure from advisor headcount and does not provide an eight-quarter series.

adjacent.text: Merrill and the Private Bank combined have more than 15,000 wealth advisors, per the November 2025 investor day deck.
adjacent.differs_because: The combined Merrill and Private Bank figure is not Merrill's own advisor headcount series.
